clauses.clause: Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.evidence: [stimulus: you draw a card]: trigger [0], 'card gets 1 PLUS_1_PLUS_1 counter(s)', 2/2 -> 3/3; [you draw two cards]: two triggers, counters 2, 4/4; [turns pass ... your next upkeep]: own draw step triggers, 1 counter; [you cast Crash Through]: its draw triggers; [the opponent draws a card]: none.
